summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated and, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line file with a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW` shifts a `const n7gIxM=[...]` table) and generated `_0x...`/`MmgoCP`-style identifiers. The package's declared purpose is a Babel React preset — its `main` (`index.js`) is a 12-line preset wrapper unrelated to `setup.mjs` / `math_init.js`, and there is no legitimate reason for a Babel preset to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime and use it to execute an obfuscated 700 KB payload at install time. The use of Bun rather than Node evades scanners that trace only Node-resolved code, and the package's scope (`@ornikar/*`, `github.com/ornikar/shared-configs`) is consistent with a compromised-publisher republish or scope impersonation of the Ornikar shared-configs preset.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
